title: V Special Premiere & Greeting
synopsis: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once "paved with gold," had fallen into a state of broken order and rampant crime. Man Zi-Keung (Zhu Yilong), a worker, is determined to rewrite his fate. After meeting flight attendant Lok Ka-Yuen (Michelle Wai), the two join forces to commit a heist, seizing a huge sum of money. This success drives Man Zi-Keung to ever greater extremes, pushing him and wealthy businessman Chan Fai-Yin (Leung Ka Fai ) deeper into a vortex of escalating confrontation. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang (Tan Jianci) and Hong Kong police officer Kwan So-San (Selena Lee) persist in investigating Man Zi-Keung. With the two police forces joining hands, the clash between good and evil is on the verge of eruption.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 90年代初，這座“遍地黃金”的欲望之城，秩序崩壞，犯罪叢生。打工仔萬梓強（朱一龍 飾）一心想改寫命運，在結識空姐駱嘉苑（衛詩雅 飾）後，兩人聯手作案，劫取巨額錢款，這次得手讓萬梓強愈發瘋狂，也將他與富商陳輝延（梁家輝 飾）推向了更深的角力漩渦中。與此同時，內地員警亓宏剛（檀健次 飾）和香港員警關蘇辰（李施嬅 飾）堅持對萬梓強進行調查，兩地警方聯手行動，正邪較量一觸即發。
